one_liner: Meta's Marketing API (Graph API) for Facebook/Instagram ads is broad and well documented, with OAuth2 and system user tokens and an official Meta-hosted MCP server. Production use on other people's ad accounts needs app review and business verification.
auth_notes: OAuth2 authorization-code flow via Facebook Login for Business with ads_management/ads_read scopes. Long-lived user tokens last about 60 days. Non-expiring system user tokens are a static token the user generates (API_KEY-like).
access_notes: Creating a developer app is free and self-serve, and works against your own ad accounts. Managing other users' ad accounts needs Meta App Review, Business Verification, and Advanced/Full Marketing API Access Tier (500 calls in 15 days with under 15% errors). The API itself has no fee.
blocker_notes: Multi-user access to other advertisers' ad accounts needs Meta App Review for ads_management/ads_read, Business Verification, and the Full access tier. Dev-mode access is rate-limited and meant for development only.

the set of Graph API endpoints at `graph.facebook.com` that create, change, and report on ads across Facebook, Instagram, and Meta's other apps.
Meta runs official remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that bring Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Meta Ads capabilities to your agentic workflows.
The server is remote-hosted at `https://mcp.facebook.com/ads` and works with any MCP-compatible AI agent.
